Crash/leak review of parameterized-SQL diff (sqlapplet/sqlcommand/sqlquery/company_server.hpp). NO crash/UB/leak found - both defects are caught exceptions = functional regressions. ROOT A (HIGH): FILTER_VALUE declared Type=FIELD in company_select.xml/company_count.xml but used as free-text inside LIKE '%:FILTER_VALUE:%'; new isValidIdentifier() regex ^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]{0,62}$ rejects spaces/apostrophes/empty -> every normal company search/count throws SQLAppletException -> Status INTERNAL. FILTER_FIELD (real column) is fine. Fix: make FILTER_VALUE a bound STRING (LIKE '%'||:v||'%') not FIELD. ROOT B (MEDIUM): unguarded std::stod/stoll on NUMERIC bindings (sqlquery.cpp:76-87, sqlcommand.cpp:76-87, company_server.hpp:101-114 AddCompany + 204-217 EditCompany) throw std::invalid_argument/out_of_range on non-numeric client JSON (SERVER_UID/OFFSET/LIMIT); these are std::logic_error, NOT caught by catch(SAException&)/catch(SQLAppletException&), fall to catch(...) ABORTED which skips con.rollback(). Fix: wrap conversions, rethrow as SQLAppletException, add catch(std::exception&) with rollback.
